content:
olivia-sre: Following the postmortem, we need concrete owners and deadlines for rollout safety: auto-rollback rules, blast-radius caps, deterministic cohorts, and CI tests. Please volunteer.

maria-eng: I'll own auto-rollback spec + runbook. Will include metric defs, thresholds, and human override UX. Target RFC: 2025-01-11.

liam-platform: I'll take blast-radius enforcement and flag-create guardrails. Proposal: prod default max 5%, stage 15%, dev no cap; per-team whitelist. ETA: 2025-01-20.

devex-sarah: I'll produce flag templates and a CI lint enforcing rolloutPolicy and rollbackConfig. Will add code snippets and a GH action. ETA: 2025-01-08.

product-joe: I'll sign off on any defaults that affect billing or auth; tag me on PRs.

infra-amy: I'll add cohort_id tagging in metrics so we can replay and backfill canary runs. ETA: 2025-01-09.

olivia-sre: For auto-rollback metrics: suggest triggers = error_rate delta >= 0.4pct sustained 3m OR p95 latency +30% sustained 5m OR anomaly_score >0.85 for 2 windows. Auto-pause then rollback after 2m if no manual resume. Maria please formalize.

deploy-bot: Staged deploy schema example:
```
deploy:
  cohort_percent: 5
  cohort_id: "canary-20250108-01"
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    rules:
      - metric: error_rate
        delta_pct: 0.004
        window_s: 180
      - metric: p95_latency
        increase_pct: 30
        window_s: 300
```

maria-eng: Plan: RFC will include tests, alerting hooks, and an incident marker creation when rollback occurs. Also require 1-click override in console.

liam-platform: Enforcement plan: add fields max_percent_prod, whitelist_teams, requires_approval on flag metadata. Block create if > global_max unless approved. Also emit audit event with created_by and approved_by.

devex-sarah: Test harness: synthetic error injection that asserts deploy-bot pauses and then rolls back. Nightly CI and run on deploy logic changes. Co-owner: maria-eng. ETA: 2025-01-15.

olivia-sre: Action items I'll add to tracking board:
- Auto-rollback RFC + runbook (maria-eng) due 2025-01-11
- Blast-radius enforcement + guardrail (liam-platform) due 2025-01-20
- Flag templates + CI lint (devex-sarah) due 2025-01-08
- Cohort tagging in telemetry (infra-amy) due 2025-01-09
- Synthetic rollback smoke test (maria-eng & devex-sarah) due 2025-01-15
- Dashboard card: active rollouts > cap & recent auto-rollbacks (olivia-sre + liam-platform) due 2025-01-22

product-joe: I'll prepare a short product policy doc for rollout percentages and loop in PMs.

olivia-sre: Scheduling a 30m sync next Thu 9am PT to review RFC drafts and tickets. Please create tickets and link here. Closing thread for now.
